summary: sync's RunE (internal/cli/sync.go) emits an explicit {"event":"sync_note","reason":"resource_alias_substituted","from":"strength","to":"workout_details"} (or a human-friendly stderr line under --agent/human mode) whenever the caller's --resources list names "strength", checked before normalizeSyncResourceAliases resolves/dedupes it. Any future regen touching resource-alias normalization must keep this note paired with the substitution so a caller never sees sync report results under a resource name they didn't ask for with no explanation.
reason: NEW ISSUE D from a second live post-fix verification sweep: `sync --resources strength --dry-run` silently reported sync_start/sync_complete events under "workout_details" with no indication "strength" was substituted, and `sync --resources workout_details,strength` reported resources:1 with no hint the two collapsed into one. The alias itself (introduced this session, workout-details-dependent-sync.json) was correct; only the caller-visible substitution signal was missing.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test/govulncheck and verify_skill.py all green. New test TestSyncCommandNotesStrengthAliasSubstitution drives the real `sync` command end-to-end and confirms the sync_note event fires with the correct from/to fields.
